amendment_1.scope: The augmentation is carried at the Lagrange widths 8, 12 and 16, the twelve point width being the wall evaluator of the paper; BMC11 is added to the controls; the ladder is refined so that successive rungs differ by at most a factor 1.25; the worst channel history on the rung below each realized minimum is reported as a multiple of the one percent bar; and the rule of the contract is applied verbatim against each Lagrange width separately.
amendment_1.rule: TRIUMPH if at every (K, M) the champion's minimum admissible N is at most half SLC's and the total time ratio at the minima is below 0.5; PARTIAL if the node ratio holds but time does not; REJECT otherwise.
amendment_1.rule_applied: The rule is applied verbatim against each Lagrange width separately: the node clause asks the champion's minimum admissible N to be at most half that width's at every (K, M), and the time clause asks the total time ratio at the realized minima to be below 0.5 at every (K, M) and shift.
